| 0 | 1 (0x01) | `fin` |

### `options`

- Type 8 bits, length 8 bits.
- The length counts the type and length fields too.
- Unknown types are kept as raw value octets.

| Type | Name | Value fields | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 (0x00) | `eol` | (type only, no length or value) |   |
| 1 (0x01) | `nop` | (type only, no length or value) |   |
| 2 (0x02) | `mss` | `value` |   |
| 3 (0x03) | `ws` | `shift` |   |
| 4 (0x04) | `sack_permitted` |   |   |
| 5 (0x05) | `sack` | `blocks` |   |
| 8 (0x08) | `timestamps` | `tsval`, `tsecr` |   |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `dst_port`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above. When decoding, `src_port` is looked up too if the first field matches no entry.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 179 (0x00b3) | [`bgp`](bgp.md) |   |
| 646 (0x0286) | [`ldp`](ldp.md) |   |

## Constraints

| Level | Rule |
|---|---|
| error | `data_offset` within 5..15 |
